I started Coinbase with the goal of increasing economic freedom in the world, and crypto is the best way to update the rails. We're now seeing another frontier technology start to disrupt financial services, with Agents becoming the interface for financial services. With AI, everyone has a private banker in their pocket, which can help you make better financial decisions.

Crypto rails, Agentic interface.

In the same way that crypto decentralized the financial system to preserve freedom, we need to decentralize AI to preserve freedom. Going back to Hayek, the way you efficiently coordinate millions of participants in an economy is with markets and prices as signals. This is what Coinbase is building: financial accounts, payment rails, and marketplaces for people and their agents to coordinate in this new economy.

What we do best at Coinbase is make frontier technologies trusted and easy to use in the financial system. We now do this with both crypto and AI.
